description:
The following are the job requirements :
 Background of a java programmer (not necessary but plus) with also a background in any Financial organization, insurance, etc.
 Strong SQL skills (proficient)
 A lot of ETL skills (will be doing a lot of ETL developing) 
 Big Data (someone who has been in an enterprise environment)
 Experience in Cloud (AWS, azure) environment is preferable
 Hadoop (strong or someone who has just dabbled in the environment)
 Agile environment
 Self-starter and not someone who will be asking a million questions 
 


 Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
 Experience of 5+ years is required.
 Great communication and presentation skills
 Expert in ETL and SQL.
